statement.p: A local restaurant has two locations. At one location, the revenue this month is {\$91{,}000} but it has been decreasing by {\$4{,}000} per month. At the other location, the annual revenue this month is {\$56{,}000} and it has been increasing by {\$2{,}000} per month. How long will it be until the two restaurant locations are taking in the same monthly revenue? And what will that monthly revenue be?
